description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about confirmation numbers.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about confirmation numbers, last updated between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-01. It must contain these sentences word for word: "When asked for a confirmation number, quote the id from the payment response."; "returns a confirmation_id in the response only"; "quote the confirmation_id". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
